control.name: Book tickets for Harbour Jazz Night

setup.data_isolation: fresh browser context and a newly provisioned fixture workspace per execution

requirements.text: A visitor can open the booking form for an event from the events list.
A booking must be for between 1 and 6 tickets. Any other number must be rejected with a validation message, and no booking is created.
The email must contain an "@". Otherwise the booking is rejected with a validation message.
After a successful booking, a confirmation page shows the event, the name and the number of tickets.
A booking can be cancelled from its confirmation page after confirming. A cancelled booking no longer appears under My bookings.
